data.title: Fish Tank Take Away
data.description: Learn about taking away objects and finding out how many are left in the fish tank.

challenges.instruction: Take away three fish. How many are left?
challenges.hint: Count the fish that are still swimming together in a row.
challenges.narration: Let's watch the fish tank and see how many fish are left after some swim away.

challenges.instruction: Take away two fish. How many are left?
challenges.hint: Look closely around the tank to count every single fish remaining.
challenges.narration: Some fish are hiding now. Tap each fish you can see to find out how many are left.

challenges.instruction: Take away three fish. How many are left?
challenges.hint: Count the fish in each little group to find the total left behind.
challenges.narration: The fish have split into friendly little groups. Let's count them all!

challenges.instruction: Take away two fish. How many are left?
challenges.hint: Follow the circle round and round as you count the remaining fish.
challenges.narration: The fish are swimming in a circle. Tap them one by one to count the ones that stay.

challenges.instruction: Take away one fish. How many are left?
challenges.hint: Take your time and tap every fish carefully so none get missed.
challenges.narration: You are doing wonderful work! Let's do one more big count of the fish left in the tank.
